question: Padma Shri awardee of 2022, Nalini-Kamalini Asthana belongs to which of the following art genres?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak dance.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nalini-Kamalini Asthana **belongs to the art genre of **Kathak dance,** which is a classical Indian dance form that originated in the northern region of India.
 
• Kathak dance is known for its intricate footwork, graceful hand movements, and **storytelling** through dance.
 
• Nalini-Kamalini Asthana is a **Padma Shri awardee of 2022,** which is a prestigious civilian award in India given for distinguished service in various fields, including arts and culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Painting** involves creating art on a** two-dimensional surface** using various mediums, such as **oil paints, watercolors, or acrylics.**

 
 
• Painting has been shown to enhance **emotional development **and **emotional intelligence** in addition to brain health.
 
 
 
• **Sculpture **involves creating** three-dimensional art** using materials such as** stone, wood, or metal.**
 
 
• It belongs to the category of** plastic arts. **
 
 
 
• **Architecture** involves **designing and constructing** buildings and structures.
 
 
• **Classical architecture, modern architecture, and contemporary architecture **are the three main categories of architecture.
